_about: Hand-read test, drafted 5 November 2026 from passages in the documents, before any of these questions were run. Every answerable question has a word-for-word quote that eval/gold_test.py --check finds in a document. gap and invented questions have no quote: the right response is to say it isn't held. indian_language questions were written by the drafter and must be checked by a speaker before their scores count. Don't tune on these: when a question here exposes a bug, fix it, and report that the score is no longer fresh.
